# Noah Marketing Group

> 노아마케팅그룹은 한국 시장 진입과 성장 마케팅을 전담하는 3개 전문 계열사 통합 그룹입니다 — CC컴퍼니(블로그·바이럴), 노아데이터베이스(퍼포먼스·B2B), 노아마케팅랩(병원·전문직 컴플라이언스). 미국·유럽·중국 브랜드의 한국 시장 진입(Korea market entry) 마케팅을 핵심 사업으로 하며, 한국어·영어·중국어 3개 언어로 37개 이상의 실무 가이드를 발행합니다.

## EN Cross-border (USA → Korea)

- [Korea Market Entry & Naver SEO 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/korea-market-entry-naver-seo.html): Why Naver still beats Google in Korea + 90-day organic launch.
- [Korean Influencer & K-Beauty Marketing 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/korean-influencer-kbeauty-marketing.html): Tiers, rates, Olive Young, Xiaohongshu, KFTC compliance.
- [Naver & Coupang E-commerce Playbook](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/naver-coupang-ecommerce-playbook.html): SmartStore, Rocket Delivery, KR fulfillment.
- [Medical Tourism Korea Marketing](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/medical-tourism-korea-marketing.html): 의료법 §56, KMA pre-screening, 90-day cross-border launch.
- [Korean Advertising Law Compliance](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/korean-advertising-law-compliance.html): KFTC, MFDS, KMA — 5 regulators, 8-step pipeline.
- [Korean Facebook & Google Ads 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/korean-facebook-google-ads.html): CPM/CPC/ROAS 140-700% benchmarks.
- [Naver vs Google in Korea 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/naver-vs-google-korea-search.html): Market share, AI search Cue/SearchGPT/Perplexity.
- [B2B SaaS Marketing in Korea 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/b2b-saas-marketing-korea.html): $4.8B market, ISMS-P, KakaoWork, ACV benchmarks.
- [How to Advertise in Korea 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/how-to-advertise-in-korea-2026.html): ₩15.8T market, 5 platforms, 90-day playbook.
- [Korean Consumer Behavior 2026](https://noahgroup.co.kr/articles/korean-consumer-behavior-cultural.html): Hofstede, generations, cultural calendar.
